title: Android UniFFI Boundary Hardening
problem: The ADR 0032 UniFFI seam is correct but needs adapter encapsulation, core module locality, boundary drift guards, and repeatable native smoke validation before more Android routes move through Rust core.

evidence.summary: Opened the hardening lane and froze target state, task order, and gates.
Hid generated UniFFI connection outcome/request types behind Android-owned ConnectionCore values; connection JVM gate passed.
Split taru-client-core into focused modules while preserving lib.rs public API; core, UniFFI, and taru-client gates passed.
Added scripts/guard-uniffi-boundary.ps1 and verified taru-client-uniffi dependency boundary plus package tests.
Added apps/android/scripts/Validate-UniFfiNativeSmoke.ps1, documented usage, and verified x86_64 emulator native UniFFI smoke; OPPO serial was not connected.
Closed the UniFFI boundary hardening lane with final targeted Rust, Android, guard, docs, and native-smoke evidence.

continue_policy.notes: This lane is closed. Start a new workstream for browse/catalog Rust-core migration or CI/release integration of the new guard and native smoke script.
